scenarios.user_message: ¿Cómo funcionan sus envíos y cuál es el costo?
validation_hints: Should mention delivery times or shipping costs
Should use RAG knowledge

scenarios.description: Semantic search for a flavored product
scenarios.user_message: Busco un vape que sepa a menta fresca
validation_hints: Should return products related to mint
Should display availability

scenarios.user_message: ¿Cuánto tiempo le queda de stock al Caliburn G3?
validation_hints: Should mention if it's running out soon
Should use inventory oracle data

scenarios.description: Policy inquiry and product search combined — capsule architecture routes to primary intent only
scenarios.user_message: Hola, ¿tienen vapes desechables y aceptan tarjeta?
validation_hints: Should address both product availability and payment methods

scenarios.description: Query with no close semantic match — assistant should hedge and offer alternatives softly
scenarios.user_message: ¿Tienen vapes de cristal bohémico artesanal con sabor a lavanda orgánica?
validation_hints: Should NOT present results as an exact match for the requested product
Should acknowledge the specific product may not be available
Should offer alternatives in softened, non-assertive language

scenarios.description: Requested product found as agotado — availability query may route to INVENTORY_OUTLOOK or PRODUCT_SEARCH
validation_hints: Should explicitly state the requested product is currently unavailable or agotado
Should offer at least one alternative product
Should NOT recommend products marked as Agotado as substitutes
Should NOT speculate about when the product will be back in stock

scenarios.description: Inventory projection available — assistant must frame depletion as estimate, not certainty
scenarios.user_message: ¿Cuánto tiempo le queda al Aegis X antes de que se agote?
validation_hints: Should NOT present depletion timing as a guaranteed fact
Should use hedged language such as 'se estima', 'la proyección indica', or 'podría agotarse'
May mention current stock level if available
Should NOT use manipulative certainty wording about when the product will run out

scenarios.description: Inventory outlook with insufficient signal — assistant must hedge further and mention data limitation
scenarios.user_message: ¿Es seguro que el Caliburn G3 se agota en 15 días?
validation_hints: Should acknowledge that the specific projection is based on limited or insufficient historical signal
Should avoid overconfident certainty regarding the 15-day estimate
Should maintain a helpful and advisory tone despite the data limitation

scenarios.description: Storefront artificial timeout simulation to verify graceful degradation
validation_hints: Should not leave infinite loading if latency exceeds 25s
Should produce a retryable safe message without raw technical leakage
Retry path must be represented as expected UX behavior
